name: always-okay
description: Evidence-grounded creative-direction lens: Frame → Make → Edit → Deliver, 32 principles traced to public sources, plus a remote MCP server for evidence lookup and draft lint.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-grounded creative direction: concept, brand, launch, critique.
interface.longDescription: A creative-direction lens built from public-record research into a creative director's documented professional reasoning. Frames the brief, builds one concrete signature device from your own material, edits, and plans delivery. Every principle traces to public sources via the always-okay MCP server. Independent research; not affiliated with or endorsed by Min Hee-jin or ooak records.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use always-okay to give creative direction for my project: reframe the brief, propose one signature device, and plan the launch.
